title: Hearty Malty Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A malty, pillowy, post-workout Mexican dish featuring cumin and cure, served in a banana leaf vessel, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malt syrup, cumin powder, and cure.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the skillet until browned on all sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, slice the onion and mince the garlic.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by slicing the cooked chicken and placing it onto a tortilla, then topping with the cooked onion and garlic.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
